THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT DEFENDANT WHITEHEAD, MARK J. RECOVER FROM PLAINTIFF MORROW, DRAPER THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES: 1800 FRANKLIN STREET, APT. 502, SAN FRANCISCO, CA 94109, CONDITIONAL JUDGMENT IN FAVOR OF DEFENDANT, CONTINGENT UPON HIS PAYMENT OF $237.15, PLUS DEFENDANT'S PORTION OF THE JUNE RENT, TO PLAINTIFF WITHIN 3 DAYS OF THIS ORDER, PLUS 5 DAYS' ALLOWANCE FOR SERVICE BY MAIL. DEFENDANT'S JUNE RENT SHOULD EQUAL 45% OF THE TOTAL RENT PAID FOR THE SUBJECT PREMISES. IF NOT PAID BY 12:00 MIDNIGHT ON JUNE 13, 2006, JUDGMENT SHALL ENTER IN FAVOR OF PLAINTIFF FOR RESTITUTION OF THE SUBJECT PREMISES, AND FOR DAMAGES CONSISTENT WITH THIS ORDER. SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT.
